faqs.q: What types of vehicles and equipment do you work on?
faqs.a: We service all makes and models—including personal cars and family SUVs, heavy-duty diesel pickups (6.0 Powerstroke specialists, Cummins, Duramax), commercial fleet trucks, Class-8 semi trucks (including air brakes), farm equipment, and construction/hydraulic equipment.

faqs.q: Do I need an appointment before bringing my vehicle or truck in?
faqs.a: Yes—services are by appointment only so our technicians can dedicate bay time and diagnostic equipment to your vehicle. We are open Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM at 113 Remington Road, Spring Branch, TX. Call (830) 388-1458 or request an appointment online.

faqs.q: Do you offer financing for engine, transmission, or diesel repairs?
faqs.a: Yes! We offer Car Care Credit by Synchrony so you can get your vehicle or work truck repaired today and pay over time with convenient monthly payments. You can apply directly online via our Synchrony Car Care link.

We specialize in pinpoint electrical diagnosis, commercial fleet maintenance packages, heavy-duty diesels, and 6.0 Powerstrokes—along with full engine replacements, transmissions, steering & suspension, brakes, air brakes, and tune-ups.

faqs.q: Can I upload photos of a check-engine code, leak, or part?
faqs.a: Yes! Upload up to 3 photos (JPG, PNG, or WebP) in the AI Dock or Quote Request form—such as a dashboard warning light, engine bay, tire/suspension wear, or VIN plate. Our Vision AI pre-scans the details so we can prepare an accurate diagnostic plan.

faqs.q: Where do online AI chat, quote requests, and demo bookings go right now?
faqs.a: Phone calls to (830) 388-1458 dial All Solutions Diesel and Auto Repair directly. During our initial Smart Site rollout, interactive AI lead capture elements (AI Dock, Assistant Chat, Quote Wizard, and Calendar) route to Michael's Tiberius accounts first and can be switched to All Solutions' direct inbox in one click.
